examples.chinese: 我朋友說這家餐廳的咖啡很好喝。

examples.chinese: 這張畫很好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng huà hěn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: This painting is brilliant. I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.

examples.chinese: 友美，妳這個週末要做什麼？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ zhè ge zhōumò yào zuò shénme?
examples.english: Youmei, what are you going to do this weekend?

examples.chinese: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
examples.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

examples.chinese: 啊！在這裡！錢包在我的書下面。
examples.pinyin: A! Zài zhèlǐ! Qiánbāo zài wǒ de shū xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Ah! There it is! The wallet is under my book.

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 這兩天天氣有點兒冷，我們週末去，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, wǒmen zhōumò qù, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is a bit cold those two days. How about we do it this weekend?

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 元真，妳的這條裙子真好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, nǐ de zhè tiáo qúnzi zhēn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: Yuanzhen, your skirt is very beautiful; I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 謝謝，這是我去年的生日禮物。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie, zhè shì wǒ qùnián de shēngrì lǐwù.
examples.english: Thanks, this is my birthday gift from last year.

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
examples.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

examples.chinese: 妳知道去哪裡買這個牌子的衣服嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào qù nǎlǐ mǎi zhè ge páizi de yīfu ma?
examples.english: Do you know where you can get this clothing brand?

examples.chinese: 妳看，這條黃色的褲子不錯吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè tiáo huángsè de kùzi búcuò ba?
examples.english: Look! This pair of yellow pants is nice, isn’t it?

examples.chinese: 很好看。這條藍的也很漂亮，藍色是今年很流行的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Hěn hǎokàn. Zhè tiáo lán de yě hěn piàoliang, lánsè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
examples.english: It is. This pair of blue pants is beautiful too. Blue is a popular color of this year.

examples.chinese: 這兩條我都去穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo wǒ dōu qù chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: I will try both on.

examples.chinese: 友美，這幾個句子的意思我不太懂，妳可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, zhè jǐ ge jùzi de yìsi wǒ bú tài dǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: Youmei, I don’t quite understand these sentences. Could you teach me?

examples.chinese: 這課真的不好學。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè zhēnde bù hǎo xué.
examples.english: This chapter is really difficult to learn.

examples.chinese: 可是這些時間我都有語言交換，不能去。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì zhèxiē shíjiān wǒ dōu yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, bù néng qù.
examples.english: But I will be doing language exchange during that time. I can’t make it.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 不是，這也是因為感冒。
examples.pinyin: Bú shì, zhè yě shì yīnwèi gǎnmào.
examples.english: No, it is also due to having a cold.

examples.chinese: 這是燈籠。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì dēnglóng.
examples.english: This is a lantern.

examples.chinese: 這是我朋友做的，因為他屬虎。妳知道十二生肖嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou zuò de, yīnwèi tā shǔ hǔ. Nǐ zhīdào shí'èr shēngxiào ma?
examples.english: This is the lantern that my friend made because his Chinese zodiac animal sign is tiger. Do you know the Chinese animal zodiac?

examples.chinese: 這個星期六是元宵節，妳跟友美會去看燈會嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqī liù shì Yuánxiāojié, nǐ gēn Yǒuměi huì qù kàn dēnghuì ma?
examples.english: This Saturday is the Lantern Festival. Will you and Youmei go to see the Lantern Carnival?

examples.chinese: 那我這個週末一定要去看看。
examples.pinyin: Nà wǒ zhè ge zhōumò yídìng yào qù kànkan.
examples.english: Well then, I must see it this weekend.

examples.english: There is the elevator! Let’s go get them now.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。

examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。

examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.english: It is not mine. It is my elder brother’s. Mine is not in the living room.

examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.english: The teacher is very satisfied with everyone's midterm exam results. On this midterm exam, everyone did very well, and the teacher feels very satisfied.

examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 透過教授的介紹，我一畢業就順利地找到了滿意的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò jiàoshòu de jièshào, wǒ yī bìyè jiù shùnlì de zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Through the professor's introduction, I smoothly found a satisfactory job as soon as I graduated.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bù mǎnyì wǒmen zhè yì zǔ de bàogào, yào wǒmen chóng zuò yí cì.
examples.english: The teacher is not satisfied with our group's report and wants us to do it again.

examples.chinese: 這個星期六，我們要在社區的草地上辦活動。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqīliù, wǒmen yào zài shèqū de cǎodì shàng bàn huódòng.
examples.english: This Saturday, we are going to hold an activity on the community lawn.

examples.chinese: 今天辦公室的冷氣不冷，可能冷氣機有問題。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān bàngōngshì de lěngqì bù lěng, kěnéng lěngqìjī yǒu wèntí.
examples.english: Today the air conditioning in the office is not cold; there might be a problem with the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子飯吃得太少了，你有什麼好辦法？
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi fàn chī de tài shǎo le, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ?
examples.english: This child eats too little food; do you have any good method?

examples.chinese: 在台灣，不少人去KTV慶祝生日或是辦活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo rén qù KTV qìngzhù shēngrì huòshì bàn huódòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, many people go to KTV to celebrate birthdays or hold events.

examples.chinese: 去KTV辦活動，是一個不錯的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Qù KTV bàn huódòng, shì yī ge bùcuò de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: Holding an event at a KTV is a pretty good choice.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"到東部的火車票很難訂，我訂了好幾次才成功。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這次社區的中秋節活動辦得很成功，大家都玩得很開心。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Dào dōngbù de huǒchēpiào hěn nán dìng, wǒ dìng le hǎojǐ cì cái chénggōng. Zhè cì shèqū de zhōngqiūjié huódòng bàn de hěn chénggōng, dàjiā dōu wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Tickets for trains to the east are hard to book; I tried several times before succeeding. This time the community's Mid-Autumn Festival event was very successful, and everyone had a great time.

examples.chinese: 昨天華語中心辦的中秋節活動，所有學生都來參加了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān Huáyǔ zhōngxīn bàn de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, suǒyǒu xuéshēng dōu lái cānjiā le.
examples.english: At the Mid-Autumn Festival activity held by the Mandarin Center yesterday, all the students came to participate.

examples.chinese: 那個老人年紀太大，沒辦法一個人生活。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎorén niánjì tài dà, méi bànfǎ yīgè rén shēnghuó.
examples.english: That old man is too old; he has no way to live by himself.

examples.chinese: 小孩子的手比較沒有力，沒辦法拿很重的東西。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi de shǒu bǐjiào méiyǒu lì, méi bànfǎ ná hěn zhòng de dōngxi.
examples.english: Children's hands have relatively little strength; they have no way to carry very heavy things.

examples.chinese: 高雄是台灣南部最大的城市，舉辦過世界運動會。
examples.pinyin: Gāoxióng shì Táiwān nánbù zuì dà de chéngshì, jǔbànguò Shìjiè Yùndònghuì.
examples.english: Kaohsiung is the largest city in southern Taiwan and has held the World Games.

examples.chinese: 他吹笛子吹得很好，辦過幾場很成功的音樂表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuī dízi chuī de hěn hǎo, bànguò jǐ chǎng hěn chénggōng de yīnyuè biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: He plays the flute very well and has held several very successful music performances.

examples.chinese: 在德國舉辦的歐洲足球比賽，一共有十二個國家報名。
examples.pinyin: Zài Déguó jǔbàn de Ōuzhōu zúqiú bǐsài, yígòng yǒu shí'èr ge guójiā bàomíng.
examples.english: For the European football match held in Germany, a total of twelve countries registered.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 黃先生這幾天一直發燒，腦子很不清楚，恐怕沒辦法寫劇本。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng zhè jǐ tiān yīzhí fāshāo, nǎozi hěn bù qīngchu, kǒngpà méi bànfǎ xiě jùběn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang has had a fever for the past few days, his brain is very unclear, and I'm afraid he won't be able to write the script.

examples.chinese: 超商常舉辦送小禮物或買一送一的活動，可是對王先生完全沒有吸引力。
examples.pinyin: Chāoshāng cháng jǔbàn sòng xiǎo lǐwù huò mǎi yī sòng yī de huódòng, kěshì duì Wáng xiānsheng wánquán méiyǒu xīyǐnlì.
examples.english: Convenience stores often hold promotions giving small gifts or buy-one-get-one-free, but they have completely no appeal to Mr. Wang.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 世界運動會的規模很大，每回舉辦時，五大洲的國家都會來參加。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè Yùndònghuì de guīmó hěn dà, měi huí jǔbàn shí, wǔ dà zhōu de guójiā dōu huì lái cānjiā.
examples.english: The scale of the World Games is very large; each time it is held, countries from five continents come to participate.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.
examples.english: This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors.

examples.chinese: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular.

examples.chinese: 路旁有很多小白花，我常常摘一些放在書桌上，看著看著心情就愉快了。進辦公室前，別忘了摘下帽子，這是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Lù páng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo bái huā, wǒ chángcháng zhāi yīxiē fàng zài shūzhuō shàng, kàn zhe kàn zhe xīnqíng jiù yúkuài le. Jìn bàngōngshì qián, bié wàng le zhāi xià màozi, zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: There are many small white flowers by the roadside; I often pick some and put them on my desk, and as I look at them, my mood becomes cheerful. Before entering the office, don't forget to take off your hat; this is a kind of courtesy.

examples.chinese: 臺北美術館最近舉辦了很有名的畫展，吸引了很多民眾去欣賞那些畫。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Měishùguǎn zuìjìn jǔbàn le hěn yǒumíng de huàzhǎn, xīyǐn le hěn duō mínzhòng qù xīnshǎng nàxiē huà.
examples.english: The Taipei Fine Arts Museum recently held a very famous painting exhibition, attracting many people to go appreciate those paintings.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: A:你知道辦理留學的手續需要準備哪些資料嗎？ B:我不清楚。你可以上網查查。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zhīdào bànlǐ liúxué de shǒuxù xūyào zhǔnbèi nǎxiē zīliào ma? B: Wǒ bù qīngchu. Nǐ kěyǐ shàngwǎng cháchá.
examples.english: A: Do you know what materials need to be prepared to deal with the procedures for studying abroad? B: I'm not sure. You can look it up online.

examples.chinese: 報名衝浪課的手續很簡單，只要到辦公室填一張基本資料表就行了。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng chōnglàng kè de shǒuxù hěn jiǎndān, zhǐyào dào bàngōngshì tián yī zhāng jīběn zīliào biǎo jiù xíng le.
examples.english: The procedure for registering for the surfing class is very simple; you just need to go to the office and fill out one basic information form.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, dì-yī cì bànlǐ hùzhào děi běnrén qīnzì qù, bùnéng qǐng biérén dàitì ma?
examples.english: In your country, the first time you apply for a passport, do you have to go in person yourself, and cannot ask someone else to do it for you?

examples.chinese: 紀先生的部落格擁有不少讀者，下個週末他要辦一場新書活動，買了新書的讀者都可以請他簽名。
examples.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng de bùluògé yōngyǒu bùshǎo dúzhě, xià gè zhōumò tā yào bàn yī chǎng xīnshū huódòng, mǎi le xīnshū de dúzhě dōu kěyǐ qǐng tā qiānmíng.
examples.english: Mr. Ji's blog has quite a few readers; next weekend he will hold a new book event, and readers who have bought the new book can ask him for an autograph.

examples.chinese: 對現代人來說，電腦和網路絕對是辦公室的主要設備。
examples.pinyin: Duì xiàndài rén lái shuō, diànnǎo hé wǎnglù juéduì shì bàngōngshì de zhǔyào shèbèi.
examples.english: For modern people, computers and the internet are definitely the main equipment in the office.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最親愛的寶貝，父母對他們的愛是沒辦法用文字來形容的。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì qīn'ài de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài shì méi bànfǎ yòng wénzì lái xíngróng de.
examples.english: Children are their parents' most beloved treasures; parents' love for them cannot be described in words.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。
examples.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ chūguó lǚxíng shí, hùzhào bèi tōu le, xìngkuī dǎoyóu tōngzhī le dāngdì de wàijiāo rényuán, hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hùzhào.
examples.english: Last time I traveled abroad, my passport was stolen; fortunately, the tour guide notified the local diplomatic personnel, and a new passport was quickly issued.

examples.chinese: 因為學校缺乏經費，宿舍的電腦設備暫時沒辦法改善。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xuéxiào quēfá jīngfèi, sùshè de diànnǎo shèbèi zànshí méi bànfǎ gǎishàn.
examples.english: Because the school lacks funds, the computer equipment in the dormitory cannot be improved for the time being.

examples.chinese: 這座地下停車場因為缺乏經費，沒辦法改善又暗又溼的情形。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dìxià tíngchēchǎng yīnwèi quēfá jīngfèi, méi bànfǎ gǎishàn yòu àn yòu shī de qíngxíng.
examples.english: Because this underground parking lot lacks funds, there is no way to improve its dark and damp condition.

examples.chinese: 到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。
examples.pinyin: Dào dìzhèn zāiqū jiùzāi de jūnrénmen, zhè jǐ tiān máng de lián yí dùn fàn dōu méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo de chī.
examples.english: The soldiers who went to the earthquake disaster area for rescue have been so busy these days that they couldn't even properly eat a single meal.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 我有很急的事找張先生，請他到辦公室後回電，謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn jí de shì zhǎo Zhāng xiānsheng, qǐng tā dào bàngōngshì hòu huídiàn, xièxie.
examples.english: I have something very urgent to discuss with Mr. Zhang; please have him call back after he arrives at the office. Thank you.

examples.chinese: 我們約好下星期一在線上開會，討論辦員工運動會的事情。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuēhǎo xià xīngqīyī zài xiànshàng kāihuì, tǎolùn bàn yuángōng yùndònghuì de shìqing.
examples.english: We agreed to hold a meeting online next Monday to discuss the matter of organizing the employees' sports meet.

examples.chinese: 我要去郵局辦事，有什麼事要我順便替你辦的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù yóujú bànshì, yǒu shénme shì yào wǒ shùnbiàn tì nǐ bàn de ma?
examples.english: I'm going to the post office to handle some affairs; is there anything you want me to handle for you while I'm at it?

examples.chinese: 天哪！這次期末考真不容易呀，要是考不好被當了，怎麼辦哪？
examples.pinyin: Tiān na! Zhè cì qīmòkǎo zhēn bù róngyì ya, yàoshì kǎo bù hǎo bèi dāng le, zěnme bàn na?
examples.english: Oh my! This final exam is really not easy—if I don't do well and get flunked, what will I do?

examples.chinese: 您想辦簽證的話，請先準備好相關證件再來辦理。
examples.pinyin: Nín xiǎng bàn qiānzhèng de huà, qǐng xiān zhǔnbèi hǎo xiāngguān zhèngjiàn zài lái bànlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to apply for a visa, please prepare the relevant documents first before coming to handle it.

examples.chinese: 銀行裡有很多種表格，看你辦什麼事，就用什麼表格。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhǒng biǎogé, kàn nǐ bàn shénme shì, jiù yòng shénme biǎogé.
examples.english: There are many kinds of forms in the bank; depending on what you're doing, you use the corresponding form.

examples.chinese: 到銀行開戶，必須本人親自去辦理。
examples.pinyin: Dào yínháng kāihù, bìxū běnrén qīnzì qù bànlǐ.
examples.english: To open an account at a bank, you must go in person to handle it.

examples.chinese: 我習慣來這家銀行存款，因為這裡的員工都十分親切。你在辦一些國家的簽證時，他們得看你的銀行存款。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn lái zhè jiā yínháng cúnkuǎn, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yuángōng dōu shífēn qīnqiè. Nǐ zài bàn yīxiē guójiā de qiānzhèng shí, tāmen děi kàn nǐ de yínháng cúnkuǎn.
examples.english: I am used to coming to this bank to deposit money, because the employees here are all very friendly. When you apply for visas for some countries, they need to see your bank savings.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠的設備及員工都嚴重缺乏，哪裡有辦法進一步發展？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de shèbèi jí yuángōng dōu yánzhòng quēfá, nǎlǐ yǒu bànfǎ jìnyībù fāzhǎn?
examples.english: That factory is severely lacking in both equipment and employees; how could there be any way to develop further?

examples.chinese: 百貨公司經常辦活動及送贈品，都是為了鼓勵客人多消費。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuò gōngsī jīngcháng bàn huódòng jí sòng zèngpǐn, dōu shì wèile gǔlì kèrén duō xiāofèi.
examples.english: Department stores often hold events and give away free gifts, all to encourage customers to spend more.

examples.chinese: 公司辦公室裡有咖啡機，隨時想煮一壺熱咖啡都很方便。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bàngōngshì lǐ yǒu kāfēijī, suíshí xiǎng zhǔ yī hú rè kāfēi dōu hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: There is a coffee machine in the company office; whenever you want to brew a pot of hot coffee, it's very convenient.

examples.chinese: 每年大學迎新時，學校總是會辦舞會歡迎大家。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dàxué yíngxīn shí, xuéxiào zǒngshì huì bàn wǔhuì huānyíng dàjiā.
examples.english: Every year during the university orientation, the school always holds a dance to welcome everyone.

examples.chinese: 文化中心跟大學合辦了一場音樂會，吸引不少民眾參加。
examples.pinyin: Wénhuà zhōngxīn gēn dàxué hé bàn le yī chǎng yīnyuèhuì, xīyǐn bùshǎo mínzhòng cānjiā.
examples.english: The cultural center and the university jointly held a concert, attracting many people to attend.

examples.chinese: 如果想入會員並享受我們健身房所提供的服務，請您到櫃臺辦理。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng rù huìyuán bìng xiǎngshòu wǒmen jiànshēnfáng suǒ tígōng de fúwù, qǐng nín dào guìtái bànlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to become a member and enjoy the services provided by our gym, please go to the counter to handle it.

examples.chinese: 他一直熱愛翻譯工作，不論多困難都會想辦法克服。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí rè'ài fānyì gōngzuò, bùlùn duō kùnnan dōu huì xiǎng bànfǎ kèfú.
examples.english: He has always been passionate about translation work; no matter how difficult it is, he will find a way to overcome it.

examples.chinese: 看見有困難的人們，有能力的話就得想辦法幫助他們，不應該不理他們。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn yǒu kùnnán de rénmen, yǒu nénglì de huà jiù děi xiǎng bànfǎ bāngzhù tāmen, bù yīnggāi bù lǐ tāmen.
examples.english: When you see people in difficulty, if you are able, you should think of ways to help them; you shouldn't pay no attention to them.

examples.chinese: 一失眠就吃藥不是好辦法，最好跟醫生談談，試著找出原因。
examples.pinyin: Yì shīmián jiù chī yào bú shì hǎo bànfǎ, zuìhǎo gēn yīshēng tántán, shìzhe zhǎo chū yuányīn.
examples.english: Taking medicine as soon as you suffer from insomnia is not a good solution; it's best to talk with a doctor and try to find the cause.

examples.chinese: 我想了許多辦法去達成公司的目標，卻還是得不到主管的支持。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng le xǔduō bànfǎ qù dáchéng gōngsī de mùbiāo, què háishì dé bú dào zhǔguǎn de zhīchí.
examples.english: I thought of many ways to achieve the company's goal, but still couldn't get the supervisor's support.

examples.chinese: 我好友都已結婚了，什麼時候才換我辦喜事，請大家喝喜酒？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoyǒu dōu yǐjīng jiéhūn le, shénme shíhòu cái huàn wǒ bàn xǐshì, qǐng dàjiā hē xǐjiǔ?
examples.english: All my good friends are already married; when will it be my turn to hold a wedding and invite everyone to drink at the wedding banquet?

examples.chinese: 我們全家都是信基督教的，不論教會舉辦什麼活動，我們都一定去參加。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen quánjiā dōu shì xìn Jīdūjiào de, bùlùn jiàohuì jǔbàn shénme huódòng, wǒmen dōu yīdìng qù cānjiā.
examples.english: Our whole family is Christian; no matter what activities the church holds, we always go to participate.

examples.chinese: 王伯伯為兒子辦喜事，擺了五十桌喜酒，熱鬧極了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng bóbo wèi érzi bàn xǐshì, bǎi le wǔshí zhuō xǐjiǔ, rènào jí le.
examples.english: Uncle Wang held a wedding for his son and set up fifty tables of wedding wine—it was extremely lively.

examples.chinese: 辦公時他常在桌上擺一杯熱咖啡，說是咖啡香能讓精神更好。
examples.pinyin: Bàngōng shí tā cháng zài zhuō shàng bǎi yī bēi rè kāfēi, shuō shì kāfēi xiāng néng ràng jīngshén gèng hǎo.
examples.english: When handling official business, he often places a cup of hot coffee on the desk, saying that the coffee aroma can make him feel more alert.

examples.chinese: 從我辦公室隔著玻璃往外看，可以看見開滿鮮花的花園。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ bàngōngshì gézhe bōlí wǎng wài kàn, kěyǐ kànjiàn kāi mǎn xiānhuā de huāyuán.
examples.english: Looking out through the glass from my office, I can see a garden full of blooming flowers.

examples.chinese: 這件事我根本不了解，所以沒辦法給你適當的建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ gēnběn bù liǎojiě, suǒyǐ méi bànfǎ gěi nǐ shìdàng de jiànyì.
examples.english: I simply don't understand this matter at all, so I have no way to give you appropriate advice.

examples.chinese: 網路商店時常在過節時舉辦降價活動來吸引顧客。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn shícháng zài guòjié shí jǔbàn jiàngjià huódòng lái xīyǐn gùkè.
examples.english: Online stores often hold discount events during festivals to attract customers.

examples.chinese: 學校的畢業典禮辦得很精彩，讓我們度過了愉快的一天。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bìyè diǎnlǐ bàn de hěn jīngcǎi, ràng wǒmen dùguò le yúkuài de yī tiān.
examples.english: The school's graduation ceremony was held wonderfully, allowing us to spend a happy day.

examples.chinese: 按照我國官方規定，民間辦理環保活動可向官方申請經費。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào wǒ guó guānfāng guīdìng, mínjiān bànlǐ huánbǎo huódòng kě xiàng guānfāng shēnqǐng jīngfèi.
examples.english: According to our country's official regulations, when non-governmental organizations hold environmental activities, they can apply to the government for funding.

examples.chinese: 他希望能在海邊舉辦婚禮，可是一直找不到理想的場地。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīwàng néng zài hǎibiān jǔbàn hūnlǐ, kěshì yīzhí zhǎo bù dào lǐxiǎng de chǎngdì.
examples.english: He hopes to hold his wedding by the seaside, but he has not been able to find an ideal venue.

examples.chinese: 網路購物辦理退貨時，必須保持商品原來的外觀才行。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù gòuwù bànlǐ tuìhuò shí, bìxū bǎochí shāngpǐn yuánlái de wàiguān cái xíng.
examples.english: When returning items purchased online, you must keep the product's original appearance.

examples.chinese: 如果您對學校課程有任何問題，歡迎至辦公室談談。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nín duì xuéxiào kèchéng yǒu rènhé wèntí, huānyíng zhì bàngōngshì tántán.
examples.english: If you have any questions about the school curriculum, you are welcome to come to the office to talk.

examples.chinese: 出國旅行最好辦個保險，發生意外時才能獲得保障。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó lǚxíng zuìhǎo bàn ge bǎoxiǎn, fāshēng yìwài shí cái néng huòdé bǎozhàng.
examples.english: When traveling abroad, it is best to get insurance; only then can you obtain protection when an accident occurs.

examples.chinese: 這次活動是公司主辦的，目的是為了增加同事之間的感情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì gōngsī zhǔbàn de, mùdì shì wèile zēngjiā tóngshì zhījiān de gǎnqíng.
examples.english: This event is organized by the company, and the purpose is to increase the bonds among colleagues.

examples.chinese: 解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué zhǒngzú zhījiān yīn wénhuà chāyì chǎnshēng de wèntí, zuì hǎo de bànfǎ jiùshì hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
examples.english: To solve problems that arise between races due to cultural differences, the best approach is mutual respect.

items.wordHook: A worker takes 辛(bitter) toil and 力(strength) → the office will 辦(handle).

examples.chinese: 現在的科技非常進步，能幫我們解決很多問題。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì fēicháng jìnbù, néng bāng wǒmen jiějué hěn duō wèntí.
examples.english: Today's technology is very advanced and can help us solve many problems.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiějué le bùshǎo zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó wèntí, yīncǐ mínzhòng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě dàdà tígāo le.
examples.english: The mayor solved quite a few of this city's living problems, therefore the people's standard of living has also greatly improved.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 他們從小時候就很要好，有困難時一起解決，有好東西也會分給對方。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen cóng xiǎoshíhou jiù hěn yàohǎo, yǒu kùnnán shí yīqǐ jiějué, yǒu hǎo dōngxi yě huì fēn gěi duìfāng.
examples.english: They have been close friends since childhood; when they have difficulties, they solve them together, and when they have good things, they share them with each other.

examples.chinese: 逃避或許是解決問題的一種方式，但有些問題是你逃不了，不得不解決的。
examples.pinyin: Táobì huòxǔ shì jiějué wèntí de yī zhǒng fāngshì, dàn yǒuxiē wèntí shì nǐ táo bù liǎo, bùdébù jiějué de.
examples.english: Escaping may be one way to solve a problem, but some problems are ones you cannot escape and have no choice but to solve.

examples.chinese: 時間有時能消除煩惱，不能解決的事就暫時放在一邊吧。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān yǒu shí néng xiāochú fánnǎo, bù néng jiějué de shì jiù zànshí fàng zài yìbiān ba.
examples.english: Time can sometimes eliminate worries; for things that can't be solved, just put them aside for the time being.

examples.chinese: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì rěnnài yīxià jiù guòqù le, shénme dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎojià de fāngshì jiějué, chízǎo huì chūshì de.
examples.english: Some things pass after enduring them for a bit; if you want to solve everything by arguing, sooner or later there will be an accident.

examples.chinese: 老師提醒學生有疑問要馬上解決，免得越到後面越不了解。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng yǒu yíwèn yào mǎshàng jiějué, miǎnde yuè dào hòumiàn yuè bù liǎojiě.
examples.english: The teacher reminded the students that if they have any questions, they should resolve them immediately, lest the further they go, the less they understand.

examples.chinese: 想有效解決身材肥胖的問題，就應避免吃太肥的肉、太油的菜，同時還得多運動。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yǒuxiào jiějué shēncái féipàng de wèntí, jiù yīng bìmiǎn chī tài féi de ròu, tài yóu de cài, tóngshí hái děi duō yùndòng.
examples.english: If you want to effectively solve the problem of being obese, you should avoid eating meat that is too fatty and dishes that are too oily, and at the same time you also need to exercise more.

examples.chinese: 解決環境受汙染的問題需要長久的計畫。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué huánjìng shòu wūrǎn de wèntí xūyào chángjiǔ de jìhuà.
examples.english: Solving the problem of environmental pollution requires a long-term plan.

examples.chinese: 難得今天有空，我們不如一口氣解決工作上所有的問題吧。
examples.pinyin: Nándé jīntiān yǒu kòng, wǒmen bùrú yìkǒuqì jiějué gōngzuò shàng suǒyǒu de wèntí ba.
examples.english: It's rare to have free time today; why don't we solve all the work problems in one go.

examples.chinese: 這項新發明解決了許多環保問題，發明的人還受國家表揚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn fāmíng jiějué le xǔduō huánbǎo wèntí, fāmíng de rén hái shòu guójiā biǎoyáng.
examples.english: This new invention solved many environmental problems, and the inventor was even praised by the country.

examples.chinese: 解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué zhǒngzú zhījiān yīn wénhuà chāyì chǎnshēng de wèntí, zuì hǎo de bànfǎ jiùshì hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
examples.english: To solve problems that arise between races due to cultural differences, the best approach is mutual respect.

examples.chinese: 孔子希望君王能夠接受他的建議來管理國家。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ xīwàng jūnwáng nénggòu jiēshòu tā de jiànyì lái guǎnlǐ guójiā.
examples.english: Confucius hoped that the king could accept his advice to govern the country.

examples.chinese: 孔子希望君王能夠接受他的建議來管理國家。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ xīwàng jūnwáng nénggòu jiēshòu tā de jiànyì lái guǎnlǐ guójiā.
examples.english: Confucius hoped that the king could accept his advice to govern the country.

examples.chinese: 童先生穿著一件綠色的襯衫，配上一條咖啡色的褲子，看起來真像一棵樹。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xiānsheng chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de chènshān, pèi shàng yī tiáo kāfēisè de kùzi, kàn qǐlái zhēn xiàng yī kē shù.
examples.english: Mr. Tong is wearing a green shirt, matched with a brown pair of pants; he really looks like a tree.

examples.chinese: 那個明星對穿著很講究，總是花很多時間，研究什麼上衣配什麼長褲才好看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng duì chuānzhuó hěn jiǎngjiū, zǒngshì huā hěn duō shíjiān, yánjiū shénme shàngyī pèi shénme chángkù cái hǎokàn.
examples.english: That star is very particular about apparel, always spending a lot of time researching what top goes with what pants to look good.

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese: 過海關時，請配合相關人員檢查行李。
examples.pinyin: Guò hǎiguān shí, qǐng pèihé xiāngguān rényuán jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
examples.english: When going through customs, please cooperate with the relevant personnel in inspecting your luggage.

examples.chinese: 茶食就是喝茶時配著吃的點心、小吃。「茶點」的意思有三種，包含：「茶食」、「茶和點心」、「用茶做的點心」。
examples.pinyin: Cháshí jiùshì hē chá shí pèi zhe chī de diǎnxīn, xiǎochī. “Chádiǎn” de yìsi yǒu sān zhǒng, bāohán: “cháshí”, “chá hé diǎnxīn”, “yòng chá zuò de diǎnxīn”.
examples.english: Tea snacks are the dim sum and small eats that accompany tea when drinking. The term “tea snacks” has three meanings, including: “tea snacks,” “tea and dim sum,” and “dim sum made with tea.”

examples.chinese: 我爺爺習慣吃中式早餐，每天早上都是吃包子配豆漿。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye xíguàn chī zhōngshì zǎocān, měitiān zǎoshang dōu shì chī bāozi pèi dòujiāng.
examples.english: My grandfather is used to eating a Chinese-style breakfast; every morning he has steamed buns with soy milk.

examples.chinese: 工作有壓力時，應適當地分配你的工作及娛樂時間。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò yǒu yālì shí, yīng shìdàng de fēnpèi nǐ de gōngzuò jí yúlè shíjiān.
examples.english: When work is stressful, you should appropriately allocate your work and leisure time.

items.wordHook: A 酉(wine) jar blends flavors with your 己(self) taste, mixing them together → 配(blend).

examples.chinese: 我媽媽很會保養，看起來又年輕又漂亮，很多人都以為我們是姊妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma hěn huì bǎoyǎng, kàn qǐlái yòu niánqīng yòu piàoliang, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒmen shì jiěmèi.
examples.english: My mother is very good at taking care of herself; she looks both young and pretty, and many people think we are sisters.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎姐妹不但長得很像，連性格也一樣開朗、大方。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi jiěmèi bùdàn zhǎng de hěn xiàng, lián xìnggé yě yíyàng kāilǎng, dàfāng.
examples.english: That pair of twin sisters not only look very much alike, but even their personalities are equally cheerful and generous.

items.wordHook: Combining 姊(elder sister) and 妹(younger sister): 姊妹 means sisters.

examples.chinese: 許多青少年為了考上好學校，不得不犧牲假日去補習。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō qīngshàonián wèile kǎo shàng hǎo xuéxiào, bùdébù xīshēng jiàrì qù bǔxí.
examples.english: Many teenagers, in order to get into a good school, have no choice but to sacrifice their holidays to go to cram school.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 那位母親寧可犧牲自己的生命，也要保護孩子的安全。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mǔqīn nìngkě xīshēng zìjǐ de shēngmìng, yě yào bǎohù háizi de ānquán.
examples.english: That mother would rather sacrifice her own life to protect her child's safety.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 小李好幾次約女網友見面，都被拒絕，所以不再跟她聯絡了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ hǎojǐ cì yuē nǚ wǎngyǒu jiànmiàn, dōu bèi jùjué, suǒyǐ bù zài gēn tā liánluò le.
examples.english: Xiao Li asked his female online friend to meet several times but was rejected each time, so he no longer contacts her.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: 在國外遇見好久沒聯絡的好友，是一件很開心的事情。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài yùjiàn hǎojiǔ méi liánluò de hǎoyǒu, shì yī jiàn hěn kāixīn de shìqing.
examples.english: Meeting a good friend you haven't contacted for a long time abroad is a very happy thing.

examples.chinese: 你想參加這項長跑比賽的話，可以到網站報名，登記之後會有人跟你聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng cānjiā zhè xiàng chángpǎo bǐsài de huà, kěyǐ dào wǎngzhàn bàomíng, dēngjì zhīhòu huì yǒu rén gēn nǐ liánluò.
examples.english: If you want to participate in this long-distance race, you can sign up on the website; after you register, someone will contact you.

items.wordHook: Combining 連(join) and 絡(web): 連絡 means connect.

examples.chinese: 張經理今天的工作行程安排得很滿，連吃飯、休息的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ jīntiān de gōngzuò xíngchéng ānpái de hěn mǎn, lián chīfàn, xiūxi de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: Manager Zhang's work schedule today is arranged very full; he doesn't even have time to eat or rest.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month.

examples.chinese: 錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。
examples.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, měitiān zhǐ xiǎngzhe zěnme ràng gōngsī chéngzhǎng de kuài yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 我住的房子不大，也沒有很多錢，可是家人都很愛我， 讓我覺得很幸福、很滿足。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de fángzi bù dà, yě méiyǒu hěn duō qián, kěshì jiārén dōu hěn ài wǒ, ràng wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú, hěn mǎnzú.
examples.english: The house I live in isn't big, and I don't have a lot of money, but my family all love me, which makes me feel very happy and satisfied.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 我有一個幸福美滿的家庭，父母都很愛我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge xìngfú měimǎn de jiātíng, fùmǔ dōu hěn ài wǒ.
examples.english: I have a happy and fulfilling family; my parents both love me very much.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"在這家餐廳吃飯，只要滿兩千塊，就送一盤水果。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"那個杯子裡裝滿了水。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, zhǐyào mǎn liǎngqiān kuài, jiù sòng yī pán shuǐguǒ. Nàge bēizi lǐ zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ.
examples.english: At this restaurant, as long as you reach 2,000 dollars, they give you a plate of fruit. That cup is full of water.

examples.chinese: 那家印尼餐廳常常客滿，你最好先打電話訂位。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā Yìnní cāntīng chángcháng kèmǎn, nǐ zuìhǎo xiān dǎ diànhuà dìngwèi.
examples.english: That Indonesian restaurant is often full; you'd better call ahead to make a reservation.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的菜又便宜又好吃，所以假日常常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī, suǒyǐ jiàrì chángcháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: That restaurant's food is both cheap and delicious, so it is often fully occupied on holidays.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn mǎnyì dàjiā zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo de chéngjī. Zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo, dàjiā dōu kǎo de hěn hǎo, lǎoshī juéde hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The teacher is very satisfied with everyone's midterm exam results. On this midterm exam, everyone did very well, and the teacher feels very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 透過教授的介紹，我一畢業就順利地找到了滿意的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò jiàoshòu de jièshào, wǒ yī bìyè jiù shùnlì de zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Through the professor's introduction, I smoothly found a satisfactory job as soon as I graduated.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ sòng wǒ de jiéhūn lǐwù hěn zhēnguì, bāohán le tāmen duì wǒ mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: The wedding gift my parents gave me is very precious; it includes their full blessings for me.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
examples.pinyin: Huālián nà jǐ jiā lǚguǎn de shuāngrén kèfáng dōu kèmǎn le, wǒmen háishì dìng mínsù ba.
examples.english: The double guest rooms at those hotels in Hualien are all fully booked; we'd better book a homestay instead.

examples.chinese: 週末的時候，火車站的賣票窗口總是排滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, huǒchēzhàn de mài piào chuāngkǒu zǒngshì pái mǎn le rén.
examples.english: On weekends, the ticket windows at the train station are always fully lined up with people.

examples.chinese: 按照商品目錄的說明，消費滿五百元可以打八五折。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào shāngpǐn mùlù de shuōmíng, xiāofèi mǎn wǔbǎi yuán kěyǐ dǎ bāwǔzhé.
examples.english: According to the product catalog, if you spend 500 yuan, you can get a 15% discount.

examples.chinese: 小王對農業很有興趣，家裡的倉庫擺滿了種田用的工具。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng duì nóngyè hěn yǒu xìngqù, jiālǐ de cāngkù bǎi mǎn le zhòngtián yòng de gōngjù.
examples.english: Xiao Wang is very interested in agriculture; the warehouse at home is filled with tools for farming.

examples.chinese: 一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiā cāntīng yàoshi shòu huānyíng, jiùsuàn bǎ diàn guān zài jiāoqū de mǒu ge xiǎo xiàngzi lǐ, yě háishì shícháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: If a restaurant is popular, even if it is tucked away in a small alley in the suburbs, it will still often be full of customers.

examples.chinese: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén zài dìtān mǎi dōngxi jiǎn lái jiǎn qù, zuìhòu yòu bù mǎi, nánguài lǎobǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāoxìng de yàngzi.
examples.english: That customer kept picking and choosing while shopping at the street stall, and in the end didn’t buy anything; no wonder the owner looked unhappy.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 元旦那天因為不少人放假，大部分餐廳都客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Yuándàn nà tiān yīnwèi bù shǎo rén fàngjià, dà bùfèn cāntīng dōu kèmǎn le.
examples.english: On New Year's Day, because many people had the day off, most restaurants were full.

examples.chinese: 這處風景區非常有名，假日都擠滿了遊客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chù fēngjǐngqū fēicháng yǒumíng, jiàrì dōu jǐ mǎn le yóukè.
examples.english: This scenic area is very famous; on holidays it is crowded with tourists.

examples.chinese: 老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bù mǎnyì wǒmen zhè yì zǔ de bàogào, yào wǒmen chóng zuò yí cì.
examples.english: The teacher is not satisfied with our group's report and wants us to do it again.

examples.chinese: 本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
examples.pinyin: Běndì shèqū de fángzi cháng bèi hàoqí de guānguāngkè pòhuài, lìng rénmen shífēn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Houses in the local community are often damaged by curious tourists, which makes people very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 從我辦公室隔著玻璃往外看，可以看見開滿鮮花的花園。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ bàngōngshì gézhe bōlí wǎng wài kàn, kěyǐ kànjiàn kāi mǎn xiānhuā de huāyuán.
examples.english: Looking out through the glass from my office, I can see a garden full of blooming flowers.

examples.chinese: 這家旅行社有宣傳活動，所以裡頭、外頭都站滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu xuānchuán huódòng, suǒyǐ lǐtou, wàitou dōu zhàn mǎn le rén.
examples.english: This travel agency has a promotional event, so both inside and outside are full of people.

examples.chinese: 每到重大節日，城市裡就到處充滿了歡樂的氣氛。
examples.pinyin: Měi dào zhòngdà jiérì, chéngshì lǐ jiù dàochù chōngmǎn le huānlè de qìfēn.
examples.english: Whenever a major festival arrives, the city is filled everywhere with a joyful atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 那棟沒有主人的房屋充滿恐怖的傳說，一般人都不願意靠近。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng méiyǒu zhǔrén de fángwū chōngmǎn kǒngbù de chuánshuō, yībān rén dōu bù yuànyì kàojìn.
examples.english: That house without an owner is full of terrifying legends; ordinary people are all unwilling to go near it.

examples.chinese: 陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà. Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great. Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 這家公司雖然要求員工得穿西裝上班，但費用全是公司負擔的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán yāoqiú yuángōng děi chuān xīzhuāng shàngbān, dàn fèiyòng quán shì gōngsī fùdān de.
examples.english: Although this company requires employees to wear suits to work, the cost is entirely borne by the company.

examples.chinese: 身體不舒服時，就應該吃對身體負擔較小、容易消化的食物。
examples.pinyin: Shēntǐ bù shūfu shí, jiù yīnggāi chī duì shēntǐ fùdān jiào xiǎo, róngyì xiāohuà de shíwù.
examples.english: When you feel unwell, you should eat food that is less of a burden on the body and easy to digest.

examples.chinese: 醫生提醒我少吃油、鹽和糖，以減輕身體的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng wǒ shǎo chī yóu, yán hé táng, yǐ jiǎnqīng shēntǐ de fùdān.
examples.english: The doctor reminded me to eat less oil, salt, and sugar in order to lighten the body's burden.

examples.chinese: 過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Guòdù xiāofèi jí shǐyòng sùjiāo cáiliào de chǎnpǐn, dōu huì zēngjiā zìrán huánjìng de fùdān.
examples.english: Excessive consumption and the use of plastic material products will both increase the burden on the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 在機構、組織擔任的職位越高，代表個人所負擔的責任越重。
examples.pinyin: Zài jīgòu, zǔzhī dānrèn de zhíwèi yuè gāo, dàibiǎo gèrén suǒ fùdān de zérèn yuè zhòng.
examples.english: The higher the position one holds in an institution or organization, the heavier the responsibility the individual bears.

examples.chinese: 黃小姐為家人買了定期健康保險，萬一有需要時就可以減輕負擔。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiǎojiě wèi jiārén mǎi le dìngqī jiànkāng bǎoxiǎn, wànyī yǒu xūyào shí jiù kěyǐ jiǎnqīng fùdān.
examples.english: Miss Huang bought regular health insurance for her family, so that if there is a need, it can reduce the burden.

items.wordHook: Combining 負(load) and 擔(bear): 負擔 means burden.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 根據美國某項研究資料，青少年因腦震盪而被送到醫院的意外中，超過一半是因為激烈運動引起的。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Měiguó mǒu xiàng yánjiū zīliào, qīngshàonián yīn nǎozhèndàng ér bèi sòng dào yīyuàn de yìwài zhōng, chāoguò yībàn shì yīnwèi jīliè yùndòng yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: According to a certain American research study, among accidents in which teenagers are sent to the hospital due to cerebral concussion, more than half are caused by intense sports.

examples.chinese: 像足球、籃球那樣激烈的運動，常讓運動員的小腿、手、腳受傷。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng zúqiú, lánqiú nàyàng jīliè de yùndòng, cháng ràng yùndòngyuán de xiǎotuǐ, shǒu, jiǎo shòushāng.
examples.english: Intense sports like soccer and basketball often cause athletes to injure their lower legs, hands, and feet.

items.wordHook: Combining 激(arouse) and 烈(fiery): 激烈 means intense, fierce.

examples.chinese: 小簡今天遇到以前的女朋友，跟她喝了咖啡才回家，但不敢跟太太說實話。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn jīntiān yùdào yǐqián de nǚpéngyǒu, gēn tā hē le kāfēi cái huí jiā, dàn bù gǎn gēn tàitai shuō shíhuà.
examples.english: Today Xiao Jian ran into his ex-girlfriend, and only went home after having coffee with her, but he didn't dare tell his wife the truth.

examples.chinese: 說實話，文憑不是最重要的，重要的是個人的知識與才能。
examples.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, wénpíng bù shì zuì zhòngyào de, zhòngyào de shì gèrén de zhīshì yǔ cáinéng.
examples.english: To be honest, a diploma is not the most important thing; what is important is a person's knowledge and ability.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

items.wordHook: Combining 總(gather) and 之(of): 總之 means all in all, in short.

examples.chinese: 今明兩天的天氣可能從晴天轉雨天，出門前記得帶傘。
examples.pinyin: Jīn míng liǎng tiān de tiānqì kěnéng cóng qíngtiān zhuǎn yǔtiān, chūmén qián jìde dài sǎn.
examples.english: The weather today and tomorrow may turn from sunny to rainy; remember to bring an umbrella before going out.

examples.chinese: 這臺洗衣機不轉了，請你拿去修理一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái xǐyījī bù zhuàn le, qǐng nǐ ná qù xiūlǐ yīxià.
examples.english: This washing machine has stopped rotating; please take it to be repaired.

examples.chinese: 你先往左轉，再往右轉，就到那家餐廳了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn, zài wǎng yòu zhuǎn, jiù dào nà jiā cāntīng le.
examples.english: First turn left, then turn right, and you'll arrive at that restaurant.

examples.chinese: 現在的手機都具有語音轉成文字的功能，用來記錄事情非常便利。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de shǒujī dōu jùyǒu yǔyīn zhuǎn chéng wénzì de gōngnéng, yòng lái jìlù shìqíng fēicháng biànlì.
examples.english: Today's mobile phones all have the function of converting voice into text, which is very convenient for recording things.

examples.chinese: 電視臺常在熱門比賽的轉播中放一些廣告，靠這種方式來賺錢。
examples.pinyin: Diànshìtái cháng zài rèmén bǐsài de zhuǎnbō zhōng fàng yīxiē guǎnggào, kào zhè zhǒng fāngshì lái zhuànqián.
examples.english: TV stations often place some advertisements during the broadcast of popular matches, relying on this method to make money.

examples.chinese: 從國外坐飛機到臺灣來，有時需要轉機。
examples.pinyin: Cóng guówài zuò fēijī dào Táiwān lái, yǒushí xūyào zhuǎnjī.
examples.english: When flying from abroad to Taiwan, sometimes you need to transfer flights.

examples.chinese: 今天搭捷運參加演唱會的民眾很多，車上擠得都不能轉身。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān dā jiéyùn cānjiā yǎnchànghuì de mínzhòng hěn duō, chē shàng jǐ de dōu bù néng zhuǎnshēn.
examples.english: There were many people taking the MRT to the concert today; the train was so crowded that you couldn't even turn around.

items.wordHook: a 車(cart) takes a 專(concentrated) arc → watching the wheels 轉(turn).

examples.chinese: 他這個月花了太多錢，因此連水電費、房租都繳不出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège yuè huā le tài duō qián, yīncǐ lián shuǐdiànfèi, fángzū dōu jiǎo bù chūlái.
examples.english: He spent too much money this month, so he can't even pay his water and electricity bills and rent.

examples.chinese: 收到帳單的時候得準時去繳費，以免超過時間後得繳更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào zhàngdān de shíhou děi zhǔnshí qù jiǎofèi, yǐmiǎn chāoguò shíjiān hòu děi jiǎo gèng duō qián.
examples.english: When you receive the bill, you must go pay it on time, so as to avoid having to pay more money after the deadline.

examples.chinese: 你的筆在那本書上面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐ zài nà běn shū shàngmiàn.
examples.english: Your pen is on top of the book.

examples.chinese: 這枝筆太貴了，你買便宜的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ tài guì le, nǐ mǎi piányi de ba.
examples.english: This pen is too expensive, you had better buy a cheaper one.

examples.chinese: A：你喜歡紅色的筆嗎？ B：我喜歡白的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xǐhuān hóngsè de bǐ ma? B: Wǒ xǐhuān bái de.
examples.english: A: Do you like red pens? B: I like white pens.

examples.chinese: 一枝筆幾塊錢？
examples.pinyin: Yì zhī bǐ jǐ kuài qián?
examples.english: How much is a pen?

examples.chinese: 我有兩枝鉛筆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī qiānbǐ.
examples.english: I have two pencils.

examples.chinese: A：你要哪種筆？ B：我要鉛筆。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào nǎ zhǒng bǐ? B: Wǒ yào qiānbǐ.
examples.english: A: What kind of pen do you want? B: I want a pencil.

examples.chinese: 這種小鉛筆怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiǎo qiānbǐ zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: What do you think about this type of small pencil?

examples.chinese: 發展科技對國家來說很重要，不過也應該注意環保問題。
examples.pinyin: Fāzhǎn kējì duì guójiā lái shuō hěn zhòngyào, bùguò yě yīnggāi zhùyì huánbǎo wèntí.
examples.english: Developing technology is very important for a country, but attention should also be paid to environmental protection issues.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠的設備及員工都嚴重缺乏，哪裡有辦法進一步發展？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de shèbèi jí yuángōng dōu yánzhòng quēfá, nǎlǐ yǒu bànfǎ jìnyībù fāzhǎn?
examples.english: That factory is severely lacking in both equipment and employees; how could there be any way to develop further?

examples.chinese: 為了發展個人事業而放下學業，多數人是很難做到的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gèrén shìyè ér fàngxià xuéyè, duōshù rén shì hěn nán zuòdào de.
examples.english: To give up one's studies in order to develop a personal career is something most people find very hard to do.

examples.chinese: 為了發展工業而不斷開發，這樣下去森林早晚會被破壞光的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gōngyè ér bùduàn kāifā, zhèyàng xiàqù sēnlín zǎowǎn huì bèi pòhuài guāng de.
examples.english: Developing industry by constantly exploiting resources, if this continues, the forests will sooner or later be completely destroyed.

examples.chinese: 臺灣企業到發展中國家設立工廠，是因為當地的人工便宜。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān qǐyè dào fāzhǎnzhōng guójiā shèlì gōngchǎng, shì yīnwèi dāngdì de réngōng piányi.
examples.english: Taiwanese enterprises set up factories in developing countries because local labor is cheap.

examples.chinese: 隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐ chǎnyè fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shòudào hěn shēn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: With the development of the electronics industry, people's living habits have also been deeply affected.

examples.chinese: 這家公司成立不到兩年，現在的規模已發展得十分完整。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chénglì bù dào liǎng nián, xiànzài de guīmó yǐ fāzhǎn de shífēn wánzhěng.
examples.english: This company was established less than two years ago, and its current scale has already developed quite completely.

examples.chinese: 他對發展新科技向來保守，不願接受人工智慧產品。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì fāzhǎn xīn kējì xiànglái bǎoshǒu, bù yuàn jiēshòu réngōng zhìhuì chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: He has always been conservative about developing new technology and is unwilling to accept artificial intelligence products.

examples.chinese: 那位母親寧可犧牲自己的生命，也要保護孩子的安全。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mǔqīn nìngkě xīshēng zìjǐ de shēngmìng, yě yào bǎohù háizi de ānquán.
examples.english: That mother would rather sacrifice her own life to protect her child's safety.

examples.chinese: 聽說那場演唱會很熱門，我們最好先預訂門票。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì hěn rèmén, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān yùdìng ménpiào.
examples.english: I heard that concert is very popular; we'd better reserve tickets in advance.

examples.chinese: 國際棒球比賽快開始了，那一群剛入棒球場、穿藍色運動服的就是臺灣隊。
examples.pinyin: Guójì bàngqiú bǐsài kuài kāishǐ le, nà yì qún gāng jìnrù bàngqiúchǎng, chuān lánsè yùndòngfú de jiùshì Táiwān duì.
examples.english: The international baseball game is about to start; that group that just entered the baseball field wearing blue sportswear is the Taiwan team.

examples.chinese: 我的球隊因為練習不夠，這一季的表現也不太理想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiúduì yīnwèi liànxí bú gòu, zhè yí jì de biǎoxiàn yě bú tài lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Because my sports team didn't practice enough, its performance this season is also not ideal.

examples.chinese: 職業棒球隊在比賽時，會請專業啦啦隊來製造熱鬧氣氛。
examples.pinyin: Zhíyè bàngqiú duì zài bǐsài shí, huì qǐng zhuānyè lālādùi lái zhìzào rènào qìfēn.
examples.english: When professional baseball teams are playing, they invite professional cheerleading squads to create a lively atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 那支軍隊受的是特殊訓練，只在發生重大戰爭時才派出。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī jūnduì shòu de shì tèshū xùnliàn, zhǐ zài fāshēng zhòngdà zhànzhēng shí cái pàichū.
examples.english: That army unit receives special training and is only dispatched when a major war occurs.

examples.chinese: 我們學校的啦啦隊隊員個子都很高，舞蹈的技巧也很出色。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lālāduì duìyuán gèzi dōu hěn gāo, wǔdǎo de jìqiǎo yě hěn chūsè.
examples.english: The cheerleading team members of our school are all very tall, and their dance skills are also excellent.

examples.chinese: 那位教授提供病毒給軍隊使用，有些人認為他應該出來道歉。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu tígōng bìngdú gěi jūnduì shǐyòng, yǒuxiē rén rènwéi tā yīnggāi chūlái dàoqiàn.
examples.english: That professor provided viruses for the military to use; some people think he should come out and apologize.

examples.chinese: 自從有了抽號機以後，人們就不需要站著排隊了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le chōuhàojī yǐhòu, rénmen jiù bù xūyào zhànzhe páiduì le.
examples.english: Ever since there have been queue ticket dispensers, people no longer need to stand in line.

examples.chinese: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"這本小說很有意思，值得推薦。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"雖然我排隊排了一個小時才買到跨年演唱會的票，可是很值得。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō hěn yǒu yìsi, zhídé tuījiàn. Suīrán wǒ páiduì pái le yí ge xiǎoshí cái mǎi dào kuànián yǎnchànghuì de piào, kěshì hěn zhídé.
examples.english: This novel is very interesting and worth recommending. Although I waited in line for an hour before I got tickets to the New Year's Eve concert, it was very worth it.

examples.chinese: 火車應該快到了，我們去前面排隊吧。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē yīnggāi kuài dào le, wǒmen qù qiánmiàn páiduì ba.
examples.english: The train should be arriving soon; let's go line up in front.

examples.chinese: 捷運站的洗手間外面有很多人在排隊，你要去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jiéyùn zhàn de xǐshǒujiān wàimiàn yǒu hěn duō rén zài páiduì, nǐ yào qù ma?
examples.english: Outside the restroom at the MRT station there are many people lining up; do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 現在坐捷運的人很多，我們需要排隊。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài zuò jiéyùn de rén hěn duō, wǒmen xūyào páiduì.
examples.english: There are many people taking the MRT now; we need to line up.

items.wordHook: a 阝(place) where 㒸(obey) players rest in rows → one united 隊(team).
To 交(connect) a 友(friend): 交友 means make friends.
午(noon) + 飯(meal) → the noon meal is lunch.
學(learn) + 期(period) → a period of learning: 學期(semester).
學(learn) + 生(life) → a life of learning: 學生(student).
Under a wide 广(broad) roof reaching the lowest foundation: 底(bottom).
慶(congratulate) + 祝(wish well) → congratulate and wish well: 慶祝(to celebrate).
Using a steady 扌(hand) to grip the throwing 殳(tool) firmly before launching it forward → 投(pitch).
Combining 採(collect) and 用(use): 採用 means adopt.
Stepping forward to 擔(bear) a trusted 任(trust) assignment: 擔任 means play the role of.
期(period) + 中(middle) + 考(test) → the test in the middle of the term: midterm test.
Possessing 真(real) authenticity in 實(real): 真實 means real.
超(super) + 級(level) + 市(market) + 場(place) → a super-level market place: supermarket.
You 走(walk) through the 旱(dry) desert, pressing on to 趕(pursue).
